blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Members of Baguio City-based group advocating for indigenous peoples’ (IP) rights on Thursday urged the Court of Appeals (CA) to overturn a local court’s decision retaining their terrorist tag for lack of probable cause and due process. The Cordillera Peoples Alliance (CPA) filed an 84-page petition for certiorari and prohibition before the appellate court seeking to set aside the April 24, 2026, decision of a Baguio regional trial court (RTC), which junked its challenge to its designation as a terror organization as well as to the constitutionality of the Anti-Terrorism Act (ATA).
